result.title: Verify--Backtrack Loop: Structured Precondition Recovery for Long-Horizon Language Agents
result.summary: Language agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks in interactive environments, where actions often depend on latent preconditions. The core difficulty is not trajectory length but recovery: when a prerequisite is missing or an earlier decomposition fails, trying another plausible action rarely helps. ReAct and later reflection or adaptive-planning methods support local correction, but express recovery as free-form text, with no explicit control state linking the terminal goal, the active goal, and the failure source. We introduce the Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL), a training-free extension of ReAct that turns precondition discovery and failure diagnosis into structured planning-state updates. VBL maintains the task decomposition as a bounded goal stack and, on goal activation, execution failure, or material state change, jointly verifies two horizons---whether the active goal contributes to the terminal goal and whether it is feasible in the current state. These dual-horizon judgments, combined with typed failure attribution, trigger explicit operations---Push, Pop, retry, or BacktrackTo the parent. We evaluate VBL with Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-V3.2 on AppWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld. VBL improves over ReAct and reflection-based control on every backbone--benchmark pair. On the challenging AppWorld setting, it improves task success by up to 22.07 percentage points over ReAct. Ablations show that removing either verification or diagnosis degrades performance, in several settings below ReAct, confirming that the two mechanisms are complementary. These results show that reliable long-horizon interaction benefits from revising the planning state, not merely the next action.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Verify–Backtrack Loop，用有界目标栈维护任务分解，在目标激活、执行失败或状态变化时做「是否服务于总目标」与「当前是否可行」的双视野验证，并结合类型化失败归因触发 Push、Pop、retry 或回退父目标的结构化控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式控制状态、目标贡献验证与失败回退机制，可能为 LVR 中何时继续思考、获取视觉证据或停止/回溯提供概念参照；但该工作为纯文本交互智能体、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，能否迁移尚需核查。
